title: Returns
text: Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery with proof of purchase. Contact support to start a return. Refunds are issued to the original payment method after inspection.

title: Shipping and tracking
text: Estimated delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees. Check the latest order status before contacting support about a delayed shipment. Tracking links are not available in this demo.

title: Delivery address changes
text: Contact support to request an address change before an order ships. An address change is not guaranteed after an order is in transit. This chatbot cannot change an address.

title: Account privacy
text: Never share payment card numbers or passwords in chat. Order lookups in this demo use seeded customer IDs only; a production service must verify customer identity before revealing orders.
